summary: Iteration 16: Frontend-only testing of 3 new features: (1) ControlsHint card, (2) UserSettingsPage 'Show Controls Hint' button, (3) RecordingsPage filter tabs + sort toggle + inline delete confirm. All visible/interactive features pass. Inline delete confirm could not be E2E-tested due to no recordings (userId=null in public view) but code review confirms correct implementation.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: ControlsHint (ControlsHint.jsx) - Fixed bottom-right (z-[9998]), gradient glow backdrop (radial-gradient), countdown bar (decrements correctly), close button (data-testid=controls-hint-close), auto-dismisses after 10s. All working.
GOOD: ControlsHint re-triggers on 'sv-show-controls' CustomEvent. UserSettingsPage dispatches this on 'Show Controls Hint Card' button click. Verified working.
GOOD: ControlsHint is rendered in Home component (App.js line 192) outside renderView(), so it persists across all views including UserSettingsPage.
GOOD: RecordingsPage filter tabs - FILTER_TABS=['all','scheduled','recording','completed','failed','cancelled'], only show if count>0 or s==='all'. 'all' tab always visible with active highlight.
GOOD: Sort toggle (data-testid=recordings-sort-toggle) toggles 'Newest first' <-> 'Oldest first' correctly.
GOOD: Inline delete confirm implemented correctly - setDeleteConfirmId(rec.id) shows inline panel with AlertTriangle warning, Cancel + Delete buttons. NO window.confirm used.
MINOR: handleDelete catch block uses alert('Failed to delete') instead of a toast/inline error notification - inconsistent UX.

NOTE: Recordings page in public view (userId=null in App.js line 165) shows 'Device not activated' - so filter tabs for statuses other than 'all' and delete inline confirm could not be E2E tested. Only 'all' filter tab visible.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable features (7/7 visible features pass; 1 feature - inline delete confirm - untestable due to no recordings in public view)
